newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Homes shares jump after suspension.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Homes shares jump after suspension.

text.p: Shares of Asahi Homes Co Ltd, which were suspended on Tuesday afternoon, jumped in the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Wednesday morning.
As of 0156 GMT, the share price was up 35 yen at 350 yen.
The share price of the construction firm briefly climbed to 365 yen.
Traders said the shares were supported by Asahi Homes' announcement on Tuesday that the firm's creditors had agreed to forgive loans worth 4.2 billion yen which they had made to it.

Trading in Asahi Homes was suspended on Tuesday prior to this announcement, because the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said information about the firm was spreading and the association needed to confirm it.
